source: Actual browser, authenticated Spring Boot/MyBatis/MySQL persistence and isolated synthetic accounts. 100-question rendering uses an explicitly labelled synthetic AI response.

checks.name: the upper-right AI page action is Save Temporarily and its theme switch is removed
incomplete requirements save to MySQL and restore in an entirely new browser context
a 100-question generated and manually revised draft saves and reopens without generating or publishing
different accounts cannot read, overwrite or clear this owners temporary draft
anonymous users and counts above 100 are rejected
temporary save failure preserves the current work and permits a successful retry
loading failure gives a recoverable warning instead of clearing work or blocking generation
the save action remains visible at the upper right on a 390px screen
clear results also removes the saved account snapshot and new contexts open blank
ordinary editor retains its existing theme switch
